However, the spec in the docstring says the return is a closed list [c0,...,ck,c0], and test_cycles in the same file asserts find_cycle([("A","B",1),("B","A",1)]) == ["A","B","A"] (closed list). The design review notes (@omar) confirm the closed list format is correct. Please fix test_regression_issue_250 to expect ["A","B","A"].
